topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Discovering that your partner has been weaving your life into the pages of a novel can be quite a revelation. It’s a peek into how they see you, the thoughts and feelings they associate with your shared journey. I imagine it’s a bit like unwrapping a gift that’s been crafted with care and consideration. There’s a lot to digest, and perhaps a few surprises too. It’s a creative expression of their world, and you’re a key part of it. Taking the time to read it, to really absorb the stories and the emotions, could bring a new depth to your understanding of each other. It’s a moment to cherish, to talk about, and to maybe even inspire your own stories.
